title: Historical baseline review — Stakelogic BV regulatory action of 25 June 2026 (RTS 14D slots timing)
description:
THIS IS A HISTORICAL BASELINE ITEM, NOT A NEW EVENT. No internal case, action or requirement record existed for the 25 June 2026 Stakelogic BV action, so this one-time review item is prepared for Regulatory Compliance with Technical Compliance participation (independent research pack 01, §C1).

What the official record shows: an official regulatory-action record concerning slots timing under RTS 14D and testing/quality-assurance processes, dated 25 June 2026.

What this item must establish, without assuming unresolved failings and without re-opening anything already closed: (1) the current RTS 14D requirement text and its commencement, taken from the standard itself rather than from this historical case; (2) whether games or processes covered by the action are still in scope today; (3) existing evidence of remediation or closure, if any, and where it is held; (4) whether any current requirement draft should reference the action as supporting context only.

Evidence to preserve: official action record https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/public-register/regulatory-action/detail/329 ; supporting announcement https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/news/article/stakelogic-bv-to-pay-gbp122-835-for-running-slots-too-fast ; the app's own successful capture of the public statement (kept as captured evidence, not re-verified here).

Related existing internal material (covers the standard, not this case): REQ-256DD842, REQ-2ffb9e65-122, REQ-55a8afbc-0c8, REQ-0828317c-2fb.
